title: Make C TX queue reads thread-safe
description: tx_queue_count, tx_queue_empty, and tx_queue_stats_get read shared queue state without locking despite the thread-safe API contract; POSIX mutations can race and cause undefined behavior. Also audit and propagate pthread_mutex_init/destroy failures. Redesign const/read API locking without unsafe casts, add concurrent host tests and sanitizer/thread-sanitizer validation.
close_reason: Read APIs (count/empty/stats_get) now lock before touching shared state incl. terminal check; snapshots returned by value, no const casts. Mutex-init failure propagates -EAGAIN with pool torn down (regression test added via CONFIG_TX_QUEUE_TEST_TIME-style hook, POSIX-only - documented). New concurrent test: 4 writers + 3 readers x 30k iters with exact accounting invariants (pushes==queued, pops==sent, ENOBUFS==dropped, payload tearing check). 39/39 pass under ASan+UBSan and TSan (3x stress, halt_on_error=1). Error-path review fixes: pthread_create/join failures no longer strand threads on dead stack; fault flag reset before assert. ASan CMake workaround kept (verified necessary - try-compile link omits flag on Apple clang); repo-wide fix filed as bead.
